description: Read current hardware sensor values from the device. Enumerates all available sensors from sensorservice and returns their last-known readings with timestamps. Sensor availability is device-dependent — the tool reports what's present. No root required.

category.description: Filter by sensor category: all, accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, light, barometer, proximity, gravity, linear_accel, rotation, orientation, motion, step, temperature

listOnly.description: If true, list available sensors without reading values (faster, useful for discovery)

name: adb_sensor_read
